description: rea round 2 - sys1 runs on the real Windows machine. The watcher pulls this branch, runs code/tasks/t3_sys1_selfcheck.ps1 (offline self-check + agent-logit decision + multi-lingual demo), and pushes results/sys1/local/SYS1_LOCAL.md back. 'Local' always means the user's scheduled watcher, never a sandbox folder.
notes: SYS1_AGENT_CHOICE must be billing: that answer is the agent's logits decoded by laya's math on the local CPU.
SYS1_HTTP_OK / SYS1_MCP_OK come from the loopback HTTP contract test and the stdio MCP test inside selfcheck.py.
Round 1's computer-use smoke is retired: it needed UIA text injection that this Windows build refuses; sys1 needs no UI.
